scope: One limited read-only check for ordinary registration on the original sandbox platform Neon database; review only

target.installer: Same existing Neon owner identity as pinned historical catalog receipt, to be matched before connecting; never the Web role

futureApprovedInputs.configuration: Read .env.local once in memory, use only existing DATABASE_URL, require exact host/port/database/actor match to the pinned historical target with verified TLS and no fallback
futureApprovedInputs.testEmail: Exactly one user-controlled address from the failed attempt, supplied as one separately approved private local input; bind once before connecting, never substitute another address or expose its derived values

catalogChecksInOrder: Exact session/current actor, database, approved target, transaction_read_only, server version and database owner compared to historical identity/OID where recorded
Fixed Web and installer role attributes, memberships (including effective inherited and SET paths), database and relevant schema metadata, and absence of candidate role/schema/function names
Web effective ACLs for the four tables and auth_sessions metadata only; proof of original users(id,email) lookup and no direct registration INSERT or privilege expansion
Exact four base tables and candidate INSERT column definitions, types, collation, nullability, defaults, generated/identity attributes and required omitted columns
Exact four tables' PK/unique/index/FK/check definitions and validity, including email and workspace membership uniqueness; no referenced-table business rows
Exact four tables' RLS and FORCE RLS, policy presence, non-internal trigger and rewrite rule metadata; no function bodies

Installer database/schema creation and PL/pgSQL use, needed schema/table grant options, ability to create the restricted role and to create/transfer owned objects without unapproved membership, relevant default ACL and provider constraints

onlyBusinessProjection.when: Only after exact target and a safe ordinary public.users lookup are established; installer eligibility may be independently blocked
onlyBusinessProjection.parameterizedSql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.users WHERE email = $1) AS email_exists, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.users WHERE id = $2) AS user_id_exists
onlyBusinessProjection.parameters: Application-normalized single email and stableId('usr', email); memory only
onlyBusinessProjection.allowedOutput: One row containing two booleans only; neither boolean proves a successful signup/session
onlyBusinessProjection.ifEitherTrue: IDENTITY_ALREADY_PRESENT: stop; do not retry registration, adopt, update, delete or pick a replacement address

decisions.targetOrScopeMismatch: STOP; no fallback, roles switch, alternate target, or query retry
decisions.webLookupMissingOrAclDrift: WEB_LOOKUP_OR_ACL_DRIFT; do not mask a missing read with grants or the registration function
decisions.unsafeTableShapeOrUnexpectedObjects: SCHEMA_OR_NAME_DRIFT; do not alter constraints, bypass RLS, reuse objects or expand scope
decisions.installerAbilityUnprovenOrUnexpectedMemb: INSTALLER_BLOCKED_OR_UNPROVEN; no trial DDL even if rolled back, no helper role, membership or escalation
decisions.allChecksMatchWithBothIdentityFlagsFalse: PRECHECK_PASSED_NOT_INSTALLED; eligible only to prepare a separate installation review within 5 hours of actual observation, not authority to execute

recording: No raw catalog dumps, configuration, URL, passwords, hashes/salts, email, email fingerprint, derived IDs, business rows, function bodies or raw errors; keep only private minimal metadata, booleans, safe reason code, actual timestamps and counts. No retries; retain previous records and slots unchanged.
